reviewLedgerIdentity.scope: manual review and disposition ledger for accepted CP-002 monitor reports

scopeStatement: This review index does not discover reports.
This review index does not ingest reports.
This review index does not read files.
This review index does not fetch APIs.
This review index does not execute commands.
This review index does not activate automations.
This review index does not mutate queue, canon, or runtime state.
This review index does not create Brain/Cortex authority.
forbiddenCapabilities: read local files live from HTML
fetch files or APIs from HTML
execute commands from the Control Panel
create a second Brain or Cortex

fields.reviewId: Stable identifier for this manual review record.
fields.reportId: Accepted CP-002 report identifier being reviewed.
fields.monitorId: Monitor identifier from the CP-002 report.
fields.laneId: Control Panel lane identifier from the approved lane vocabulary.
fields.reviewedAt: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp for manual review.
fields.reviewedBy: Human operator who performed the review.
fields.reviewStatus: One of the allowed manual review statuses.
fields.disposition: One of the allowed manual dispositions.
fields.severity: Highest relevant severity/classification for the reviewed item.
fields.linkedFindingIds: Finding IDs from the source report or manual review.
fields.linkedEvidenceIds: Evidence IDs from the source report or manual review.
fields.proposedWorkOrderIds: Work Order IDs suggested by the report or reviewer.
fields.createdWorkOrderIds: Work Order IDs actually created after human decision.
fields.rejectedFindingIds: Finding IDs rejected by manual review.
fields.deferredFindingIds: Finding IDs deferred by manual review.
fields.blockedFindingIds: Finding IDs blocked pending decision or evidence.
fields.finalHandling: Final handling value for the reviewed item.

rules: Reference evidence IDs or report evidence IDs without embedding protected data or raw evidence content.
Use evidenceSummary for short non-sensitive operator summaries only.
Use evidenceLocation for static path, report ID, or external run URL references only.
Do not include secrets, credentials, county data, PACS data, owner-sensitive data, appeals evidence, exemptions evidence, valuation evidence, or protected data.

workOrderLinkage.proposedWorkOrderIds: Suggested Work Order IDs from the report or reviewer. These do not authorize mutation.
workOrderLinkage.createdWorkOrderIds: Work Order IDs actually created after a human decision.
workOrderLinkage.rule: A proposed Work Order remains a proposal until a separate Work Order is created and approved by the human operator.

reviewRecordMustRejectOrBlockIf: asks the Control Panel to execute commands
asks the HTML page to fetch/read local files
creates a second Brain/Cortex or autonomous queue
rejectionRules.p0P1EvidenceRule: P0 and P1 review records require at least one linked evidence ID or report evidence ID.
rejectionRules.protectedDataRule: Use metadata, redacted references, or synthetic examples only. Do not embed protected operational data in the review index.

meanings.no-action: Reviewed and no further action is needed.
meanings.proposed-wo: Converted into a proposed Work Order prompt or ID.
meanings.wo-created: A separate Work Order was created after human decision.
meanings.blocked: Blocked pending evidence, decision, or boundary correction.
